start.content: Look at this mess! Ink spilled everywhere, ledgers torn, Tyrian shekels scattered into the filth! We operate under a legal lease signed by the high priest himself. Our weights are fair, our rates are posted! He calls this a den of thieves, but without us, no traveler could buy an unblemished sacrifice!

choices.text: Why must it be Tyrian coinage specifically?
Where did the crowd go after the tables fell?

ritual.content: The Law forbids images of foreign kings in the inner house. Tyrian silver is pure—it has no emperor's face on it. It is logistics, not greed!

fallout.content: They scattered toward the outer gates, singing like madmen. The priests are inside meeting right now. This will not stand.

closing.content: The conversation is over. Go in peace.
